restraints_config._comment: RGI RMSD restraint: drive the Kabsch-superposed RMSD of atom_selection_target toward target_rmsd vs a reference PDB (ref_pdb + atom_selection_ref); minimized by CG each step. Generate ref_pdb first (e.g. a vanilla prediction of this sequence converted to PDB via gemmi make_pdb_string) and save as rmsd_ref.pdb. RUN: export OPENFOLD_CACHE=$HOME/.openfold3; run_openfold predict --query-json rmsd_example.json --output-dir out_rmsd --num-diffusion-samples 2 --use-msa-server false --use-templates false. gpu = torch device (true=GPU, false=CPU). Atoms pair by selection ORDER; the two selections MUST match in count (mismatch -> error). Selection DSL is chain/resid/index. '_comment' keys are ignored by the parser.

rmsd_restraints_config._comment: Drive residues 90-180 to match the reference (RMSD -> 0). start_sigma optional (omit -> every step); weight optional (default 1.0).
